generated_by.method: web search + page reads; official sources preferred. Most endpoints were verified by live logged-out HTTP probes (curl, identifying User-Agent, single requests) on 2026-11-22. 'verified: true' means the endpoint returned the described data that day or the fact was read on the vendor's own page.

_meta.http_probes_note: About 90 more single logged-out HTTP requests (curl) went to API endpoints, docs pages and robots.txt files. They are not counted in pages_read.
open_questions: Adzuna: official list of supported country codes is not on the docs pages read; probing returns AUTH_FAIL for any code (even 'xx') without a key, so the list could not be confirmed. Also unconfirmed: free-tier rate limits and whether max_days_old / sort_by=date are accepted (third-party wrappers say yes).
Jooble: free-key request quota (a third-party page claims 500 lifetime requests per key; unconfirmed). jooble.org/api/about returned a Cloudflare challenge to curl.
Careerjet v4: list of supported locale_code values and any rate limits (docs page read, list not captured). Requires publisher account key.
The Muse public API: https://www.themuse.com/api/public/jobs returned 404 on 2026-11-22; the developers page loads but no API text could be extracted. Status (moved/discontinued) unknown.
BambooHR careers JSON (https://{sub}.bamboohr.com/careers/list): not verified; test subdomains redirected to bamboohr.com marketing page. Needs a known customer subdomain to test.
JazzHR: no public no-auth job-list endpoint was found or verified; the official API needs an employer API key.
Workday cxs: the date field is relative text ('Posted Today' verified; other phrasings unverified). Whether the job-detail endpoint returns an absolute date was not verified.
Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/Recruitee/SmartRecruiters: no numeric rate limits are published for public GET endpoints (Greenhouse says only 'Requests may be rate limited').
Lever createdAt: present in live responses (epoch ms) but not in the documented field table.
Ashby publishedAt is documented as 'when the job was last published', so a re-published job looks new.
Indeed: exact current anti-scraping clause text was not reached (legal page truncated at 100k chars); robots.txt only partly reviewed.
Meta v. Bright Data (2024) and other post-hiQ logged-out scraping decisions were not researched here.
Relocate.me, Japan Dev, Welcome to the Jungle (Otta), Wellfound, Built In, Levels.fyi jobs: no public job API found; terms pages not read.
Arbeitnow UK variant of the API: the blog says it launched in 2026, but its URL was not captured.

Landing.jobs /api/v1/jobs returned JSON, but robots.txt disallows /api/ and no public docs were found; ordering and pagination semantics unclear (first 50 results' newest published_at was 2026-11-04).
Datasets of ATS company slugs: only LastRound AI ATS directory (DataHub) and ConorsCode/open-jobs-data companies.json were surfaced; neither was opened or checked for license/freshness.
Common Crawl CDX index (CC-MAIN-2026-43) timed out (504) for a wildcard query on jobs.ashbyhq.com/*; feasibility for slug discovery unconfirmed.

sources.name: Greenhouse Job Board API
sources.reputation_note: Employer-owned postings direct from the ATS; widely used by tech companies in US/EU/UK. Scams are rare because only paying customers post.

fields.posted_date: first_published (ISO 8601, present in live list response) ; updated_at (ISO 8601)
fields.other: absolute_url, title, company_name, application_deadline, metadata; meta.total

access.notes: GET endpoints need no auth (only application POST needs Basic Auth). Docs: 'Requests may be rate limited for security and traffic reasons' (no number). boards.greenhouse.io robots.txt has no Disallow for User-agent *. One call returns all jobs (no pagination; stripe = 777 jobs, ~485 KB without content=true). Fetch without content=true for the daily scan; fetch single job with content for description/visa keyword matching.

sources.company_discovery: Token = slug in boards.greenhouse.io/{token} or job-boards.greenhouse.io/{token}, or the gh_jid links on company career pages. Sources: (1) match company names from government sponsor registers (UK Register of Licensed Sponsors, NL IND recognised sponsors, etc.) and probe candidate slugs (lowercased name with spaces/punctuation removed); a 404 means no board. (2) Public slug lists such as LastRound AI ATS directory (DataHub) and ConorsCode/open-jobs-data companies.json (unverified). (3) HN 'Who is hiring' comments often link Greenhouse boards (parse URLs). (4) Common Crawl CDX index for boards.greenhouse.io/* (unconfirmed, timed out in test). Tokens are case-insensitive.

sources.name: Lever Postings API
sources.reputation_note: Employer-owned ATS postings. Lever's own README says published postings are publicly viewable and 'may be scraped by third parties'.

fields.posted_date: createdAt (epoch milliseconds; in live responses but not in documented field table)
fields.other: hostedUrl, applyUrl, text (title), categories.commitment/team/department, descriptionPlain, lists[], additionalPlain

access.notes: No listing rate limit documented (only application POST: >2 req/s returns 429). Unknown slug returns {"ok":false,"error":"Document not found"} with 404. EU-hosted customers live on api.eu.lever.co; try global, then EU, on 404. Note jobs.lever.co (HTML) robots.txt disallows / for *, so use the API host, not HTML pages.

sources.company_discovery: Slug = path in jobs.lever.co/{company}. Slugs are case-sensitive per third-party notes. Same discovery pipeline as Greenhouse (sponsor-register name to probe; HN 'Who is hiring' links; public slug lists).

sources.name: Ashby Public Job Posting API
sources.reputation_note: ATS widely used by startups and scale-ups (2023-2026). Official documented public API.

fields.posted_date: publishedAt (ISO; documented as 'when the job was last published')
fields.other: title, department, team, employmentType, jobUrl, applyUrl, descriptionPlain/Html, compensation

access.notes: Documented public API. Responses can be large because full descriptions are always included (ramp: ~3.4 MB), so fetch at most daily per company and cache. jobs.ashbyhq.com robots.txt disallows /api/ on that host, but the documented API is on api.ashbyhq.com.

sources.company_discovery: job_board_name = path in jobs.ashbyhq.com/{name} (case-insensitive per third-party notes). Same pipeline: register-name probing, HN links, public slug lists.

sources.name: SmartRecruiters Posting API
sources.reputation_note: Enterprise ATS; strong in Europe (e.g. Poland, Germany) and large multinationals.

fields.location: location.city, location.region, location.country (ISO2 lowercase), location.remote, location.hybrid, location.fullLocation
fields.other: name (title), company.identifier, refNumber, totalFound

access.notes: Docs say the Public Posting API 'supports both API Key and OAuth', but the list endpoint returned data with no auth on 2026-11-22. A wrong identifier returns 200 with totalFound 0 (no 404), so check totalFound when probing. Identifier is case-sensitive in practice ('Visa' returned 0).

sources.company_discovery: Identifier = path segment in jobs.smartrecruiters.com/{Identifier}/... or careers.smartrecruiters.com/{Identifier}. Use register-name probing (accept only totalFound>0 and company.name match).

sources.name: Workable public job endpoints
sources.reputation_note: SMB/mid-market ATS, popular in Europe (Greece, UK, NL) and globally.

fields.posted_date: v1 widget: published_on and created_at (YYYY-MM-DD); v3: published (ISO)
fields.location: v1: country, city, state, telecommuting, locations[]; v3: location.countryCode, locations[], remote, workplace
fields.other: title, shortcode, url, application_url, employment_type, department, function, industry

access.notes: These widget/careers-page endpoints are not a formally documented developer API (the official Workable API needs an account token). The widget endpoint is what Workable's own embeddable job widget uses. Unknown subdomain returns 404 'Not Found'. Prefer v1 widget GET (one call, all jobs).

sources.company_discovery: Subdomain = path in apply.workable.com/{subdomain}/ or legacy {subdomain}.workable.com. Use register-name probing (404 = none).

sources.name: Recruitee careers-site API
sources.reputation_note: Popular with Dutch/EU companies (e.g. bunq). Good fit for NL sponsor-register matching.

fields.posted_date: published_at and created_at ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC'), updated_at, close_at
fields.location: locations[].country_code / city / country, country_code, city, remote, hybrid, on_site

sources.company_discovery: Subdomain of {company}.recruitee.com (custom career domains often still expose the subdomain). Probe from NL/EU sponsor register names.

sources.name: LinkedIn logged-out (guest) job search
sources.reputation_note: Biggest volume, but many reposts and agency listings.
sources.endpoint_template_note: This is a deep link for the USER's browser (link_only). The guest HTML-fragment endpoint https://www.linkedin.com/jobs-guest/jobs/api/seeMoreJobPostings/search?keywords=&location=&f_TPR=r604800&start={0,25,..} answered 200 logged-out with job cards (each with <time class=job-search-card__listdate datetime=YYYY-MM-DD>), but robots.txt disallows /jobs-guest/. Do NOT call it from the app.

access.rate_limit: JobSpy README: LinkedIn rate-limits bursts with HTTP 429 that clears in about a minute

LinkedIn ended Dec 2022 with a consent judgment against hiQ ($500k, permanent injunction), after a Nov 2022 ruling that the anti-scraping user-agreement terms are enforceable as contract. f_TPR=r604800 = past 7 days (seconds); r86400 = 24h.

tier_1_build_first.what: Greenhouse + Lever + Ashby public APIs (then Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor)
tier_1_build_first.why: Employer-owned, no auth, stable JSON with posting dates and locations, permissive or documented public use. Best trust signal. Filter newest-first on first_published / createdAt / publishedAt within 7 days.

tier_1_build_first.what: Seed company list = government sponsor registers (UK licensed sponsors, NL IND recognised sponsors, etc.) joined to ATS slugs by probing
tier_1_build_first.why: Turns the sponsor register into both a discovery list and a sponsorship-confidence signal. Probe each candidate slug once, cache hits AND misses for 30 days, re-scan hits daily.
Only free no-key API found with a server-side visa-sponsorship filter (Germany/EU focus).

tier_1_build_first.what: HN 'Who is hiring?' via Algolia, filtered for VISA/RELOCATION and created_at_i in last 7 days
tier_1_build_first.why: Free official API, direct-from-employer posts, explicit VISA tag convention.

tier_1_build_first.what: Adzuna API (free key), sort_by=date, max_days_old=7, keywords incl. 'visa sponsorship'
tier_1_build_first.why: Multi-country aggregator with created date; covers the main destination markets. Confirm country list and parameters with a key.

linkedin_indeed_stance.detail: Do not call LinkedIn's /jobs-guest/ endpoints or scrape Indeed from the app, even logged-out. LinkedIn's robots.txt explicitly disallows /jobs-guest/ and prohibits automated access without permission. Its User Agreement s.8.2 bans scraping and bots and covers Visitors. hiQ lost in the end (Dec 2022 consent judgment, $500k, injunction) after the court upheld the contract claim. Indeed's terms bind API/automated access and ban bots on Indeed Apply. Instead, generate pre-filled search deep links the user opens in their own browser: LinkedIn f_TPR=r604800 (7 days) with keywords like 'visa sponsorship' plus country; Indeed fromage=7&sort=date on the country host. Optionally, the user may paste or import job URLs, and the app enriches them from JSON-LD when it is present.
linkedin_indeed_stance.jobspy: Do not ship JobSpy enabled. If offered at all: an opt-in, user-initiated, low-volume plugin with no proxies and clear ToS warnings, sites limited to those not prohibiting it. MIT licensed. Sites/countries are listed in the jobspy entry.

polite_scraping_defaults.user_agent: Shorebound/<version> (+https://<project-url>; personal job-search tool) — identify honestly, never spoof browsers
polite_scraping_defaults.robots_txt: Fetch and cache robots.txt per host (24h). Obey Disallow for HTML/crawl paths. Where a vendor publishes an API but robots.txt disallows /api/ (Remotive, RemoteOK), use the API only as the vendor documents it, at the documented cadence.
polite_scraping_defaults.rate: One in-flight request per host. At most 1 request/second per host (Jobicy requires >=1s). Add jitter. Aggregators: Remotive max 4/day; WWR at most hourly (ttl 60); others 1-4/day. ATS boards: once per company per day.
polite_scraping_defaults.caching: Store responses with ETag/Last-Modified and send If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since. Keep a local job store keyed by source+id so only new IDs are processed. Cache negative slug probes (404 / totalFound=0) for 30 days.
polite_scraping_defaults.backoff: On 429/503, honour Retry-After, else exponential backoff (e.g. 1m, 5m, 30m) and pause that host for the run. Stop on 403 or captcha pages; do not retry with new IPs or proxies.
polite_scraping_defaults.attribution: Always link to the original listing URL. Credit Remotive, Remote OK and Jobicy as their terms require. Do not republish their data to third parties.
